name: L08-fix
delta:
SEED ROLES. The FIRST image is the crowd exemplar — use its anonymous crowd proportion, face tier and the bounded 2-3 flat head-tone set it repeats; take nothing of its dress, period or setting, which each scene authors for itself. The SECOND image is the `prop-beige-pc` prop canonical — preserve that object's design.

A shop aisle head-on: four `prop-beige-pc` units sail through the air across the top of the frame trailing loose polystyrene chunks, over a rear-zone press of shoppers who have ducked in behind the slat shelving with their arms up and their eyes wide, every one of them drawn on the flat CROWD RIG only - dot eyes and one simple mouth with no eyebrows, head tones limited to at most 2-3 repeating flat shades shared across the whole group. White slat shelving stage-right with one whole shelf swept bare, a wire basket tipped over on the floor. Cream-grey-amber palette, flat strip light, foreground depth from a cropped end-cap unit cutting the lower-right corner.

prompt_suffix: Clean flat 2.5D vector cartoon in The Second Take house style: even medium-thick dark warm brown-black (#241a12) outline on everything, flat cel colours with gentle soft shading, rounded friendly shapes, no realistic detail; built-but-flat environment (flat gradient sky/ground + minimal geometry + one foreground depth prop); any in-world lettering hand-lettered in the marker style, short and legible; locked 2-3 colour scene palette plus the single red accent #d7402b used only semantically (alarm / prohibition / ownership / the last punch element); no photorealism, no on-screen narrator or host face, no unrequested text, no logos; 16:9.
why: no cast — the scene composes from the place; RETRY overlay from `L08`
